subject: Private deployment topology & compliance follow-up
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearpathbio.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearpathbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo — private deployment topology & next steps

Thanks again for your time this morning — appreciated the walkthrough, Oliver. High level recap and next actions from the Redwood side below so we have alignment before Ben and Lauren pick up the RFI and evidence requests.

Summary (one line): ClearPath Bio is evaluating a private/VPC or air-gapped on-prem deployment to satisfy data residency and regulatory controls; primary constraints are E2E encryption, key management, and minimal egress.

Action items (Redwood / ClearPath owners):
- ClearPath: share current network topology (VPC/subnet mapping) + any existing data flow diagram for ML inference (owner: Oliver) — target: EOD 10/14. (attachment: network_diagram_sketch.png)
- ClearPath: confirm SOC 2 status and whether any control statements for external vendors are already in place (Lisa) — quick note about timing below.
- Redwood (Ben): start vendor RFI with prioritized questions on KMS, egress, account separation, and incident response. Ben will send a draft by 10/13.
- Redwood (Lauren): open a shared evidence folder and provide a short checklist for what we need to evaluate GAPs vs SOC 2 / HIPAA (Lauren will share Drive link).

Questions we still have from the call:
1) Are there hard requirements for on-prem (air-gapped) vs a private VPC with dedicated tenancy? If air-gap is required we’ll need to map exact hardware/process constraints.
2) Data classification & retention policy for model input/output — is PHI expected in inference payloads? If PHI is possible we will treat this as HIPAA scope.
3) Preferred KMS model: customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or Redwood-managed with customer key wrapping?

Attachments referenced: clearpath_rfi_v1.pdf (draft RFI skeleton), soc2-summary.pdf (Redwood SOC 2 checklist).

Next call: propose 10/16 10:00 PT for a short procurement run-through + topology review. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(m) 415-555-0123
(attachment: clearpath_rfi_v1.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearpathbio.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearpathbio.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Post-demo — private deployment topology & next steps

Thanks Marcus — good summary. Quick answers on our end:

SOC 2: currently engaged with an auditor; Type II expected Q1 2026. We have a small SOC 2 Type I report from 2024 that covers some platform controls but not every vendor integration. I can share the summary PDF (will attach updated version).

On-prem vs VPC: procurement preference today is a private VPC with dedicated tenancy in our cloud account, but our compliance team has flagged a potential air-gapped requirement for a pilot workload that will process sensitive clinical data. We need to understand what operational overhead Redwood expects for air-gapped installs (patching, telemetry, upgrade cadence).

PHI: yes — pilot contains PHI. We expect encrypted transport and at-rest encryption with customer-controlled keys.

I attached a rough network diagram (attachment: clearpath_net_v1.png) that shows their current edge & private subnet layout — it's high level but should help start the mapping conversation. Procurement loop: procurement@clearpathbio.com (they asked to be cc'd on contracts).

Oliver
Director of Infrastructure | ClearPath Bio
(attachment: clearpath_net_v1.png)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearpathbio.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearpathbio.com>, procurement@clearpathbio.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps + draft RFI coming (Ben)

Oliver / Lisa / procurement team — appreciate the quick turnaround and the diagram, that helps.

Ben is looping in a first-pass RFI focusing on the highest-impact items for a private deployment pilot:
- KMS & HSM support (customer-managed key workflows, rotation, sealing).
- Network egress & outbound exact ports/protocols (we need this for your SOC/HIPAA boundary).
- Audit logs and retention (who has access, retention windows, syslog/S3 export options).
- Upgrade/patch policies for on-prem installers (if air-gap is required).

Ben: can you please send the RFI draft today and include a short mutual action plan with dates (we should capture the 10/16 topology call and a target evidence upload by 10/21)?

Oliver — regarding PHI: we'll mark HIPAA as in-scope and treat evidence accordingly. Please confirm the classification level (e.g., limited dataset vs full PHI) when you share the data flow diagram.

Ben (internal note): please prioritize KMS + egress question set and add a short 'red flags' section.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment: clearpath_rfi_v1.pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearpathbio.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement@clearpathbio.com
Date: 2025-10-13T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence checklist + shared folder (next steps)

Hi Oliver / Marcus — looping in a slightly more prescriptive evidence/next-steps list so procurement has visibility. I created the Drive folder and a short checklist in the top-level README (link below).

Required evidence for initial security review (tier 1):
- High-level network/topology diagram (edge -> private subnets -> inference cluster) (owner: ClearPath) (attachment accepted: PNG/PDF)
- SOC 2 summary or auditor contact + any vendor control exceptions (owner: ClearPath)
- Data classification statement and sample retention policy for inference payloads (owner: ClearPath)
- Preferred KMS model & certificate for HSM if used (owner: ClearPath)
- Proof of IAM separation (service accounts, roles, and which teams can access keys)
- Procurement: PO template / contracting lead contact to expedite procurement timelines

Timeline proposal:
- 10/14: topology + data classification (ClearPath)
- 10/16: topology + procurement call (mutual) — confirm by tomorrow if this slot works
- 10/21: initial evidence upload to Drive (ClearPath)
- 10/24: Redwood initial review and redline + clarifying Qs (Redwood)

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_shared_folder
DocuSign NDA (if you prefer): https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/packet/abc123

If you prefer an on-prem pilot (air-gap) we'll add an expanded evidence set (installer runbooks, patching cadence, and remote support procedures). Please confirm which path you want prioritized.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
(attachment: network_diagram_sketch.png)
